local-tool-preparation.title: Quick command configuration
local-tool-preparation.intro: Prepare a new configuration file for the selected {{tool}} on the target machine.
local-tool-preparation.output_help: Enter an absolute .json path on the target machine. Execution requires an existing parent and rejects existing files or linked directories.
local-tool-preparation.copy_failed: Copy failed. Manually copy the current command above.
local-tool-preparation.copy_boundary: Only the command was copied. No file has been created.
local-tool-preparation.incomplete: Choose a shell and enter a valid new output JSON path.
local-tool-preparation.blocked: Resolve the current unconfirmed operation before preparing configuration.
local-tool-preparation.unsupported: This tool requires its dedicated preparation. Check the tool selection.
local-tool-preparation.boundary: Copying or using a path does not execute the command or establish that a file exists. Explicitly run it on the target machine. The original tool performs bounded passive version checks and creates a new configuration; it does not install, log in, call a model, register or enable a tool.
